Home is not an app list
The home screen shows your clock, search and favorites. Installed apps live in the drawer. Telos apps sit next to them as one icon each.
Search is the main way in
Type an app, a contact, a setting or a calculation. You can also tap the magnifying glass. Greeklish and typos still match.
The app drawer
Open the drawer for every installed app. Telos Phone, Files, Store and the others appear once, with the same names as on the home screen.
Dock and favorites
Press and hold an app to pin it. The dock stays at the bottom so your daily apps are one tap away.
Widgets on home
Turn on widgets, then use the edit button on home. A short overlay explains add, move, resize and stack. You can play that overlay again in Settings.
Gestures
Swipe from home to open search or the drawer, depending on your settings. Change this under Settings → Gestures.
Locks and privacy
You can lock Settings and some Telos apps with the device lock. Hidden contacts and frozen apps stay out of search until you allow them.
Look and transparency
Theme, shapes and wallpaper blur live in Settings → Appearance. They apply to the launcher and to Telos apps together.
What search shows
In Settings → Search you choose apps, contacts, files, web and settings results. Fewer switches means a quieter search.
Gestures and dock
Settings → Home screen and Gestures control pages, the dock and swipe actions.
Widgets tutorial
If widgets feel unclear, open Home screen settings and tap Reset tutorial. The four-step overlay runs again.
System and Shizuku
Telos System is for live status and advanced tools. Shizuku is optional. You do not need it for calling, files, notes or search.
